description: This PHP source file defines the class 'CallFormBase' which extends 'FormBase'. It contains methods for rendering and processing a web form for creating or editing call records in the SuiteCRM application. The class includes methods for generating form headers, footers, body content, and handling save operations, including relationship management with users, contacts, and leads.

classes.name: CallFormBase
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering and processing call record forms in SuiteCRM, including form generation, data validation, relationship management, and saving logic.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form body for creating or editing a call, including input fields and JavaScript calendar setup.

methods.name: getFormHeader
methods.description: Returns the HTML header portion of the call form, optionally with a custom title.

methods.name: getFormFooter
methods.description: Returns the closing HTML for the call form, including buttons and footer scripts.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Assembles the complete HTML form by combining header, body, and footer.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data, performs validation, updates relationships, and saves the call record.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates an alternative wide layout version of the form body, with additional input fields and layout adjustments.
